## Change / 修改

Describe the new work or correction and its primary source.

## Evidence / 证据

What did you read? What is retained, how long, and which component consumes it?

## Checks / 检查

- [ ] IDs, DOI and titles checked for duplicates
- [ ] Primary domain, method, role and review depth are explicit
- [ ] English and Chinese notes are complete
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate.py`
- [ ] `python3 scripts/build.py`
- [ ] `python3 scripts/check_site.py`
- [ ] No private data or third-party PDFs/raw abstracts included
